_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Source snapshot is the 24 October 2025 DOJ announcement and its individual defendant/charge roster. All 33 statuses are historical charged snapshots; later outcomes were not established by the reviewed sources through September 2026. The indictment alleges a drug trafficking organization, and each defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty. Group-level drugs are not imputed to particular people. United States is a broad historical operating country for this case; no precise sites, schedules, routes, residences, live whereabouts, photos, or inferred person links are included.

organizations.name: Weymouth Street Drug Trafficking Organization (2025 case)

sources.title: 33 Alleged Members of Violent Kensington Drug Trafficking Organization Charged in 41-Count Indictment
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice / U.S. Attorney, Eastern District of Pennsylvania
sources.claim: DOJ reports an indictment alleging the Weymouth Street Drug Trafficking Organization operated in the United States from about 2016 to 2025, with 33 named defendants. These remain allegations, and defendants are presumed innocent.
